correctness.rationale: Bilinear Nijenhuis torsion for an idempotent is equivalent to its image and kernel being Lie subalgebras; the three mutually disjoint relative positions to V exhaust ordered complements, yielding two counts \(q^{r(m-r+1)}\) times invariant-subspace quantities and the exact \((q-1)q^m\) disjoint-pair term. Boundary ranks, rank symmetry and all specializations follow. Direct original-identity enumeration independently matches eleven finite-field cases, including four genuine extension-field configurations. Finite checks are corroboration rather than the general proof.

value.rationale: Natural complete rank-resolved invariant of every finite-field almost-Abelian Lie algebra. The two-sided disjoint invariant-pair incidence term is structurally necessary and distinguishes maps where neither image nor kernel is contained in the abelian ideal. Complete sharp contrasts for cyclic Jordan, irreducible and scalar actions give distinct rank-support patterns in every dimension, a motivated distinction not a low-order special-case computation.
